title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Remove obsolete permissions from all permission sets
summary: Business Central provides a built-in feature to remove obsolete permissions from user-defined permission sets when database objects are deprecated. System permission sets cannot be edited through this feature, requiring manual cleanup in extensions instead.
key_points: Permission sets contain permissions for specific database objects and must be assigned to users for Business Central access
When objects are marked as ObsoleteState = Removed during version updates, associated permissions must be cleaned up
The Remove Obsolete Permissions action on the Permission Sets page automatically removes deprecated permissions from user-defined sets
System permission sets are read-only and cannot use this feature, requiring manual cleanup or regeneration in extensions
This feature removes specific permissions but cannot delete entire obsolete permission sets

quotes.text: On the Permission Sets page, choose the Remove Obsolete Permissions action.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the standard feature for cleaning up deprecated permissions from user-defined permission sets automatically.

quotes.text: This feature removes permissions from a permission set, not the permission set itself.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the scope of the feature to prevent misunderstanding about what gets removed.
